instruction: Open 'character.png' in GIMP and resize the image to 640x640 pixels. Save the resized image as 'character_resized.png' on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires resizing a 1280x1280 image to 640x640 pixels using GIMP. Evaluator checks that the output file has exactly 640x640 dimensions. Original image verified to be 1280x1280 RGB JPEG.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 if both width and height are 640, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: resizing to 640x640 pixels and saving to the specified output file
Getter logic correctly extracts image dimensions from the output file using PIL
Metric logic correctly compares actual vs expected dimensions using exact equality (appropriate for pixel dimensions)
File existence check is properly handled - returns 0.0 if file doesn't exist or can't be opened
